name: plow yoga pose
description: An inverted yoga pose where the legs are lowered behind the head. It stretches the spine, shoulders and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your legs and hips up and over, supporting your lower back with your hands if needed.
Lower your toes toward the floor behind your head.
Keep your neck relaxed and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.
